title: I-Lang Benchmark: a reproducible test suite for I-Lang prompts
description: A benchmark suite that runs I-Lang prompts and natural-language baselines over the same 30 tasks in six categories: text summarisation, table transformation, code generation, data extraction, multi-turn workflows and complex pipelines. It ships the test cases, the runner scripts, the collected results and a report template, and runs against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint or offline in mock mode. A separate sub-benchmark tests whether the v5.0 judgment mapping from the 11-dimension vector to a decision mode is learnable from examples.
